entities.summary: David Mark Neuhaus, SJ is a German-South African-Israeli Catholic priest who served as superior of the Jesuit community at the Pontifical Biblical Institute in Jerusalem. From 2009 to 2017, he served as patriarchal vicar for Hebrew-speaking Catholics in the Latin Patriarchate of Jerusalem.
